title: Email Activity event (inbound message ingest for phishing triage)
summary: OCSF Email Activity events the phishing_triage playbook consumes when a reported or swept message lands at the secure email gateway. Carries the envelope, headers, and authentication outcomes (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) used by header-enrichment, suppression, and intent-classification steps.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Network Activity category — Email Activity class (uid 4009)
